public_rationale: The forecast has no deadline. Research and company results show meaningful gains from broader data and newer training approaches, but the cited results do not establish that data scaling alone solves reliable general household robotics. Continuing limitations also cannot prove that it never will. No decisive event meeting the resolution rule was found by October 28, 2026.
limitations: The search is not an exhaustive audit of every robotic system.
Company demonstrations do not provide independent confirmation of broad reliability.
Any eventual ruling will depend on a defensible interpretation of 'data alone' and 'solve'.

statement.document_title: What’s wrong with Google’s new robot project

our_interpretation: Read the context as concerning reliable, broadly capable household robots that handle unfamiliar situations safely.
Read 'enough' as sufficiency of increased training data, rather than a denial that data can improve performance.
A decisive test must separate gains from more data from gains requiring additional methods.
No deadline, numeric reliability threshold, or fixed definition of a data-only approach is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: A decisive result establishes that increasing data alone cannot deliver the relevant household competence and reliability, under a clearly specified class of approaches.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Replicated evaluations demonstrate reliable, broad household competence in unfamiliar situations, with controlled evidence showing that scaling training data supplied the sufficient advance.

evidence.explanation: The study reports better transfer as training environments and objects become more diverse, including strong results on two tasks. Those bounded successes show the value of scaling but do not establish reliable general household robotics.

The company reports broader task and robot transfer, making this material evidence against assuming little progress. Its account also describes diverse prompting and conditioning methods; it does not isolate data quantity or establish the required general household reliability.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Replicated, sustained household evaluations with controlled evidence isolating data scaling as sufficient, or a rigorous applicable limit showing that data scaling alone cannot meet the defined requirements.
